summary: Monday hooks pass plus news scan: added 3 global topics (US inflation and energy, the Fed's 28 Oct decision and credit cards, the UK price cap myth) and 3 proposals, wrote a UK CPI event-day file and extended the calendar with Fed, ECB, BoE and CPI dates.
why: The feed was all India while the channel went global on 18 Oct. BLS shows US energy prices up 20.4% (CPI 3.7%), the Fed decides in 9 days, and Ofgem's cap is £1,723, all checked on official pages. Our narrator was am_michael on 3 Shorts in a row (random, not rotated), and v-20261018-02 opened with a warm-up line instead of its stakes.
